# introduction
Read the guidelines at .github/copilot-instructions. You have the role of reviewer, you will write plans for analyzer and then start an analyzer subagent to carry out that those plans. It is up to you how to schedule and send off the tasks to analyzer subagent(s), but keep the work of each subagent isolated. Be careful of recompiling executables which might be in use by another program. If there is a chance a file is being edited or executable ran or will soon-to-be ran by anther subagent, then wait until that subagent's task has concluded. For analysis production use 20-30 threads, for skimming use 5 threads for mc and 10 threads for data.

# upgrading statistical uncertainty to use jackknife resampling
Follow the directions at .github/saved_prompts/20260429a.md on implementation for jackknife resampling for statistical uncertainty calculation. We are only conncerned about recalculating the uncertainty on the following plots:
    - pPb and Pbp data comparison plots (all plots in the Analysis: Combining pPb and Pbp section)
    - pp and combined pPb+Pbp results plots (all plots in the Results overleaf section)
Implement the jackknife resampling such that these plots can be remade. To verify the efficacy of the resampling technique remake the following plots using the ZpT 0-500 GeV and trk pT 0.5-15 GeV bin
 - pPb and Pbp data comparison, e.g. Fig 29 of the analysis note
 - pp and pPb result plot for deltaphi (Fig. 40), deltaeta (Fig. 42).
There is no need to implement statistical uncertainty bars for MC as these are not plotted in the result plots.
BE CAREFUL as to not override the current output .root analysis productions that are used in the overleaf. The overleaf is frozen and all .root files used for analysis and plotting should be frozen. For outputs implementing the jackknife stats, adopt a new naming convention such as adding a _jackknife_ string to the name.


# conclusion
Make the minimum number of edits necessary to implement functionality. Do not add superflous error statement catches or checks. 

Have the subanalyzer handoff a summary to you and you should review that summary for flaws. DO NOT update copilot instructions on this task as we are just exploring this new stat unc strategy. However DO return with a .md summary of the changes made.
